title: 第6章 尘埃落定，带全家买大房子-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    时光飞逝。

    两个星期后。

    张志国的判决结果下来了。

    职务侵占罪，数额巨大，判处有期徒刑八年。

    张磊作为共犯和直接参与者，判处有期徒刑五年。

    消息传回筒子楼家属院的时候，正赶上傍晚六点多，家家户户做饭的点。

    整栋楼的油烟味里，全是议论声。

    “八年！张志国判了八年！”

    “活该！那狗东西这两年在厂里捞了多少黑心钱，报应来了！”

    “他儿子张磊也进去了？那可真是一窝端了……”

    “我就说嘛，林家那小子不是一般人。你看那天开着奥迪回来，箱子里全是现金——啧啧，人家现在出息了，跟以前不一样了。”

    “可不是嘛，张志国那老东西也有今天，活该活该。”

    林川站在二楼走廊的窗户边，听着楼下七嘴八舌的动静，嘴角微微一勾。

    八年。

    上一世张志国吃干抹净，拍拍屁股走人，连根毛都没掉。

    这一世，该还的总得还。

    他转身回屋，把窗户关上，隔绝了外面的嘈杂。

    ——

    张家出事的第二天。

    刘梅来了。

    林川下楼准备开车出门的时候，她就站在单元门口的梧桐树下。

    瘦了不少，妆也没化利索，眼圈乌青，头发随便扎了个马尾。

    身上穿的那件碎花裙子，还是去年林川用加班费给她买的。

    “林川。”

    她叫住他，声音又轻又哑，像是在嗓子眼里磨了好几遍才挤出来的。

    “我知道你恨我。但是……张磊进去了，他妈把我从他家赶出来了，我现在连个住的地方都没有。你能不能……”

    “能不能什么？”

    林川拉开车门，连头都没回。

    刘梅咬着嘴唇，眼眶一下子就红了。

    她往前迈了两步，声音开始发颤：“林川，我错了，我真的知道错了。当初是我瞎了眼，我不该跟张磊……你要是还愿意给我一次机会，我什么都听你的，我伺候你爸妈，我——”

    “刘梅。”

    林川终于转过身。

    他看着她，目光平静，嘴角甚至还带着一点笑。

    但那个笑，比不笑还冷。

    “你来找我之前，有没有想过一个问题？”

    刘梅愣住了。

    “张家的案子还在查。张志国和张磊进去了，经手那些钱的人，一个一个都得过筛子。”

    他顿了顿，声音不大，像在聊一件跟自己无关的事。

    “你的名字，在好几笔转账记录上，我去做的证，不用谢。”

    刘梅的脸色变了。

    不是慢慢变白，是一瞬间，血色从脸上全部退干净。

    林川没再多看她一眼，弯腰坐进驾驶座，拉上车门。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Time flies.

Two weeks later.

The verdict of Zhang Zhiguo has come down.

The crime of official embezzlement, involving a huge amount, was sentenced to eight years in prison.

As an accomplice and direct participant, Zhang Lei was sentenced to five years in prison.

When the news came back to the Tongzilou Family Courtyard, it was around six o'clock in the evening, when every household was cooking.

The smell of oil smoke in the whole building was filled with the sound of discussion.

"Eight years! Zhang Zhiguo was sentenced to eight years!"

"You deserve it! That bitch has made so much dirty money in the factory in the past two years, retribution is coming!"

"His son Zhang Lei also went in? That's really a big deal..."

"Let me tell you, that guy from the Lin family is not an ordinary person. Look at the car he drove back that day in his Audi, and the box was full of cash - tsk tsk, he's making a living now, it's different from before."

"Isn't that right? That old guy Zhang Zhiguo is also here today. He deserves it."

Lin Chuan stood by the window in the corridor on the second floor, listening to the chatter downstairs, and the corner of his mouth curled up slightly.

Eight years.

In the previous life, Zhang Zhiguo ate everything, patted his butt and left without even losing a hair.

In this life, you must pay back what is due.

He turned around and went back to the house, closing the window to block out the noise outside.

——

The second day after something happened to the Zhang family.

Liu Mei is here.

When Lin Chuan went downstairs to drive out, she stood under the sycamore tree at the door of the unit.

She lost a lot of weight, her makeup was not put on neatly, her eyes were dark and her hair was tied into a ponytail.

The floral skirt she was wearing was bought for her by Lin Chuan with overtime pay last year.

"Linchuan."

She called him, her voice soft and hoarse, as if she had grinded it in her throat several times before squeezing it out.

"I know you hate me. But... Zhang Lei went in and his mother kicked me out of his house. I don't even have a place to live now. Can you..."

"Can there be anything?"

Lin Chuan opened the car door without even looking back.

Liu Mei bit her lip, her eyes suddenly turned red.

She took two steps forward and her voice began to tremble: "Lin Chuan, I was wrong, I really know I was wrong. I was blind at the beginning, I shouldn't have followed Zhang Lei... If you are still willing to give me another chance, I will listen to you in everything, and I will serve your parents, I -"

"Liu Mei."

Lin Chuan finally turned around.

He looked at her with calm eyes and even a little smile on his lips.

But that smile is colder than not smiling at all.

"Before you came to me, have you thought about a question?"

Liu Mei was stunned.

"The Zhang family's case is still under investigation. Zhang Zhiguo and Zhang Lei have gone in, and everyone who handles the money must pass the screening one by one."

He paused, his voice was low, as if he was talking about something that had nothing to do with him.

"Your name is on several transfer records. I'll make the certificate. You're welcome."

Liu Mei’s expression changed.

It didn’t turn white slowly, but in an instant, all the blood faded from the face.

Lin Chuan didn't look at her again, bent down and sat in the driver's seat, and closed the door.
